languageStandard.description: Defaults to c17 for C and c++23 for C++ when omitted or null.

releaseThreadDomain.description: unknown preserves the raw native proxy API; any explicitly asserts that destruction is valid on every closing thread. This remains UserAsserted and does not establish native retention or stop-and-join quiescence.
